name: regression-divergence
note: Regression fixture (unmasked). The candidate buffer deliberately diverges from Chrome inside a small 48x24px region of the box (a simulated sub-pixel rasterization difference, e.g. an antialiased edge). That region is ~1.5% of the viewport and its per-pixel delta-E is ~5, so the screenshot layer must FAIL: exceeding-pixel fraction above the 1% tolerance. Other layers match exactly and pass.

screenshot.reason: Deliberate 48x24px divergence region (~1.5% of the viewport, per-pixel delta-E ~5) injected into the candidate buffer to prove the screenshot layer's <=1% exceed gate fails as designed; the other three layers match exactly. Owner: the harness regression self-test (see the fixture note).
screenshot.sunset: Permanent harness regression guard, not an engine gap — no expiry; retire only when the screenshot layer gains an independent divergence-injection check that does not require a fixture.
